description: FREE pre-check (100/day per wallet; pass caller). Returns assessability only - whether the catalogue id exists and the window is well-formed; no counts and no grade are returned. The snapshot itself is the paid observatory_snapshot call.

caller.description: Solana base58 wallet of the operator; keys the free allowance (100/day per wallet).

catalogue_id.description: One catalogue id from GET /catalogue (e.g. discovery-total).

window.description: UTC-day window, inclusive: { start: YYYY-MM-DD, end: YYYY-MM-DD }, max 366 days.

name: observatory_precheck
